claim_boundary: Public ARC-GEN discovery and held-out evidence only; no sealed external result, unrestricted language invention, or world-level breakthrough.
discovery_rule: retain every abstract exact structure independently solving at least two distinct discovery identities

enumeration.candidate_order: depth, output type order, total node count, canonical serialization
enumeration.deduplication: retain lowest node count then canonical serialization for each semantic signature
enumeration.depth_rationale: Depth 5 is the minimum needed to compose colour -> points -> components -> selection -> selected points -> paint.
enumeration.enumeration_order: depth, type, node count, canonical serialization
enumeration.semantic_signature: type plus canonical values across all six demonstrations
enumeration.stop_rule: stop only after all depth <= 4 expressions or deterministic expression budget exhaustion

identity_selection_source: frozen v19r5 eligible registry; all v21-v24 identities excluded before ranking
nontriviality_rule: A task counts only if at least one demonstration output differs from its input and the exact Grid expression is not semantically identical to input_grid across all demonstrations.
structure_abstraction: replace distinct literal colours in first-occurrence order with typed colour parameters; background and derived colours remain operators
validation_rule: freeze discovery library before importing validation generators; infer colour parameters only; exactly one abstract structure must be exact
verifier_requirement: independent evaluator and mutation-based verifier co-synthesis for every held-out success
